newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 21.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Mayor of Abidjan's plush Cocody district unveils plans to crack down on insecurity and shantytowns and improve the quality of life there. - Ivory Coast's commercial capital Abidjan will host a major Afro-Music festival from December 2 to 12 1998 but needs help with the funding, organisers say La VOIE - Students at the University of Abobo-Adjame in Abidjan did not return to classes despite May 20 education ministry deadline; the ministry has threatened to declare academic year void (1$=580 CFA) -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
